description: Inline page-level soft error (SPEC §2.3.4). Carried on a 200 Page Manifest: the page stays usable while something failed (e.g. partial results). Codes MUST come from the soft-error subset; hard failures use the Error Envelope over 4xx/5xx instead.

code.description: Const string, e.g. app.err.partial.results or a namespaced app.err.vendor.<vendor>.<name>.

recoverable_actions.description: Action IDs that exist in /actions the agent may retry/recover with.

details.description: Map of typed StateNodes carrying error context (max 16 keys).
